description: This file defines the IPCReceiver class, a component that creates a server socket to listen for incoming inter-process communication requests, handles them via a callback handler, and manages threading for concurrent request processing.

classes.name: IPCReceiver
classes.description: A server component that listens for IPC requests over a socket, processes incoming messages, and responds accordingly. It manages threading and socket lifecycle, and operates as a subclass of Task for asynchronous execution.

classes.name: IPCReceiver.Request
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable, responsible for handling individual socket requests: reading messages, processing via handler, and sending responses.

methods.name: IPCReceiver(int port)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with a specified port and thread pool.

methods.name: getPortNumber
methods.description: Returns the port number the server socket is listening on.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the current IPCReceiverHandler assigned to this receiver.

methods.name: startReceiveThread
methods.description: Starts the server socket listening thread with a specified request handler callback.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server socket and thread pool, terminating the receiver.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Overrides Task.start(), throws RuntimeException to prevent misuse.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Overrides Task.cancel(), throws RuntimeException to prevent misuse.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main loop for accepting incoming socket connections and spawning request handling threads.
